name: lattice-marp-cli-pin
description: The marp-cli the Marp integration tests render with: the FLOOR of the range Lattice supports (MARP_SUPPORT in lib/export/marp-bundle.js), marp-cli and marp-core both. Pinned and locked so a test never fetches it; see test/helpers/marp-cli.js. The newest release in the range runs nightly (LATTICE_MARP_CLI=range).
